title: Still reaching for my parchment paper.
text: Still reaching for my parchment paper.. I haven’t had the high heat issues like others have mentioned but I do think these are difficult to clean. They never feel/look clean. Always greasy feeling. Maybe silpat brand is the same, I don’t know. Bottom line, these keep me reaching for my parchment paper.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Silicone, Non-Stick, Food Safe Baking Mat - Pack of 2
features: 2 non-stick silicone baking mats for easy and convenient baking, roasting and food prep
Non-stick silicone releases food without the need for grease, cooking sprays, or parchment paper
Do not put the mats directly on oven rack, a tray as supporter is needed.
Fits half-sheet size pans; easy to clean with soap and warm water
Each baking mat measures approximately 11.6 x 16.5 inches (LxW)
